It's hard to wrap my head around the idea of a pixel artist actually making music videos. I'm involved in the medium, and the amount of work involved in that is ridiculous.

Some of the pixel art around is legendary. I do love this video for it. If you look at it closely you can see where they are using some static frames and moving them around, but I think that adds to the charm... they are making little movement look like a lot.

Compare art like http://www.pixeljoint.com/pixelart/10301.htm with the art in the video. The video has good art considering it's designed to be animated, though it's easy to see some labor-saving methods with the limited colors, fakebit rendering, and modern animation techniques.

Imagine making the above piece's style into a 5 minute film and have it retain the same level of detail. Would be an enormous task.
